Dear Mindrift Team,

I am excited to apply for the Web Designer role on the Tendem project. With hands-on experience in UI/web design, WordPress development, and conversion-focused layouts, I am confident in my ability to create clean, on-brand, and implementation-ready web designs.

In my current role at Episto, I build and maintain client websites using WordPress and Elementor, ensuring responsive design and visual consistency. My project mirook.com showcases my ability to design multi-page sites with strong typography and clear hierarchy, while also implementing technical SEO and structured data to enhance visibility. I am proficient in Figma for creating scalable layouts and design systems, and I understand the importance of preparing files for seamless developer handoff.

I am a self-directed worker with a user-centric approach, and I am comfortable working from rough prompts or existing brand systems. My portfolio at mirook.com demonstrates my web design capabilities, including landing pages and marketing sites.

I am eager to contribute to the Tendem project and help create high-quality web designs. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Mindrift Team,

I am writing to express my interest in the Web Designer position for the Tendem project. With a strong foundation in web design, UI principles, and conversion-driven layouts, I am excited about the opportunity to create high-quality, implementation-ready web designs that align with your brand ecosystem.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have honed my skills in building and maintaining client websites using WordPress, Elementor, and the Astra theme. I focus on responsive design, visual consistency, and user-centric layouts that drive engagement. My work involves translating brand assets into structured web components, ensuring that every page is polished and aligned with the overall brand identity.

My personal project, mirook.com, is a testament to my web design capabilities. I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing a clear visual hierarchy, strong typography, and conversion-focused sections. I also integrated social media and structured data to enhance the site's visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This project demonstrates my ability to work independently, from concept to delivery, and to prepare production-ready files for seamless handoff.

I am proficient in Figma for creating scalable, responsive layouts and design systems, and I understand the importance of preparing assets for developers or no-code tools like Webflow and Framer. My attention to detail ensures that spacing, clarity, and modern web trends are consistently applied.

I am a self-directed professional with a user-centric approach, and I am comfortable working from rough prompts or existing brand systems. My portfolio at mirook.com showcases my web design work, including landing pages and marketing sites. I am eager to bring my skills to the Tendem project and contribute to creating high-converting, visually compelling web experiences.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can add value to your team.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
